name: dup2
description: The dup2() system call duplicates a file descriptor, making the specified newfd refer to the same open file description as oldfd. If newfd was previously open, it is closed first. This operation is performed atomically to prevent race conditions.

parameters.name: newfd
parameters.description: The file descriptor number to use for the duplicate; if already open, it is closed before reuse

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set

errors.description: oldfd isn’t an open file descriptor
newfd is out of the allowed range for file descriptors
This may be returned by dup2() during a race condition with open(2) and dup()
The dup2() call was interrupted by a signal
The per-process limit on the number of open file descriptors has been reached

bugs: dup2() may return different errors compared to fcntl(F_DUPFD), and any errors from closing newfd are not reported.
